goal: Stop gossiped multicast IP addresses from entering addrman and being dialed
Prevents nodes from wasting outbound connection slots on unreachable multicast targets
agreement: Asked whether scope should cover existing addrman entries or just new gossip (ValeraFinebits)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because filtering unreachable multicast addresses provides address-hygiene benefits that are deferrable
Wasting outbound connection slots on multicast peers is a low-severity edge case
